query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accountingMappings (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  managementAccountId INT NOT NULL,
  accountingCode VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  accountingName VARCHAR(150),
  effectiveDate TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  endDate TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX mgmt_account_idx (managementAccountId),
  INDEX accounting_code_idx (accountingCode),
  INDEX effective_date_idx (effectiveDate)
);
